reason: The report regresses outcome on treatment with no controls, even though pre-period confounders (2020 sales, export history, prior export growth) correlate with supplier diversity. When I add the 2020 pre-treatment controls, the coefficient falls from about 1.5–1.8 to 0.05 (SE 0.25), which is indistinguishable from zero, so the 'positive effect' is confounding.
